title: Odmowa zasiłku macierzyńskiego: brak ubezpieczenia chorobowego w dniu porodu (wniosek złożony dla uzyskania decyzji odmownej dla instytucji zagranicznej)
extractionNotes: Formal refusal decision citing UZ art. 1 ust. 1 and art. 29 ust. 1: the child was born on 2025-02-03 while the claimant was not covered by sickness insurance; refused for 2025-02-03..2026-02-01. The case summary notes no registration for sickness insurance, so no title is modelled. The ZAM (filed 2025-05-23, about 3.5 months after the birth) carries the claimant's remark that she applies to obtain a refusal for a foreign institution (EU coordination). Requested maternity from the birth and parental to 2026-02-01; the handwritten intermediate dates are only partly legible, so the split is the statutory 140 + 224 days, consistent with the printed refusal period. The decision date is redacted; asOf = application date printed in the decision. expectedDate is set to the birth date (inferred) so the pre-event replay has a due date. Rate box not reliably legible (averaged rate assumed). Other parent not described.
